facts.text: setPressure() calls OB1_Set_Press and getPressure() calls OB1_Get_Press; both convert through the calibration array
The pressure set point is in mbar
The recorded pressure columns are in mbar
getFlowUniversal() returns the flow sensor readout in uL/min
getSensorData() returns the sensor reading in its native units, probably uL/min
startRemote() starts the background control loop and sets insideRemote
stopRemote() stops the background control loop and clears insideRemote
remoteGetData() returns the pressure and sensor reading inside the remote loop
setPressure() and getPressure() refuse while the remote loop is running
getSensorData() refuses while the remote loop is running
The pressure range depends on the installed regulator type; printRegulatorTypes() lists the regulator options, including non-installed 0
loadCallibration() loads the pressure calibration array into self.calib
close() stops a running remote loop and then calls OB1_Destructor
The module controls the Elveflow OB1 pressure controller, tested on Mk4
